title: fastdrop
description: Launch board for MCP products: discover probed listings, search by real tools, submit as a maker.
summary: Launch board for MCP products: discover probed listings, search by real tools, submit as a maker.
offersHint: Launch board for MCP products: discover probed listings, search by real tools, submit as a maker. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://fastdrop.dev/mcp

toolsPreview.name: list_launches
toolsPreview.description: List live product launches on FastDrop, ranked by votes. Each product may include an MCP endpoint URL, mcpVerified (whether FastDrop probe succeeded), and mcpAuthRequired when the endpoint answered 401/403.

toolsPreview.name: get_product
toolsPreview.description: Get one live FastDrop product by its slug. Returns the MCP URL if set, mcpVerified, last-verified timestamp when available, and the probed tool list (name + description) read from the endpoint - not maker-supplied tags.

toolsPreview.name: search_products
toolsPreview.description: Search live FastDrop products by name/tagline text and/or curated tag. Optionally filter to x402-payable services (listed in the Bazaar catalog). Results ranked by votes and include verification status (mcpVerified) and freshness where available.

toolsPreview.name: find_tools
toolsPreview.description: Find live FastDrop products by capability. Searches the actual tool lists FastDrop read from each endpoint via tools/list - not maker-supplied tags or descriptions.

toolsPreview.name: list_reviews
toolsPreview.description: List reviews for a live FastDrop product by its slug. Returns the average rating, total count, and individual reviews (rating, body, author, date). Unauthenticated - available to any agent.

toolsPreview.name: list_comments
toolsPreview.description: List comments for a live FastDrop product by its slug, as a two-level tree (top-level comments and their replies). Removed comments appear as a {deleted: true} tombstone. Unauthenticated - available to any agent.
